english: The day before the Watanagashi festival… how many times has it been, I wonder?
Shall we do the memory check?
We're fine!
I've made sure everyone's memories\nare nice and clear!
Everyone's gradually getting used to it.
So coming here really does\nmake you forget something.
But once someone tells us, our memories\ncome right back. Strange, isn't it?
Where could those black ones be?
Shall I scout from above with my IS?
We don't know how much they've\nfigured out about our movements, but\nstanding out probably isn't a good idea.
We still don't know the enemy's goal or numbers.
Caution first, then.
What we know is\nthe enemy's coming for Rika-chan.
Then that settles things quickly.
Is that so?
Even if we stay quiet, the enemy will come to uss.
Unlike before,\nwe won't leave Rika-chan's side, and\nwe won't fall for any traps they set.
So the enemy's coming at us fair and square, desuu?
So cheap tricks won't work on them.\nWhy don't we flip it and set something up ourselves?
Speak of the devil -\nlooks like they're already here!
Huh?
High-speed flying object confirmed.\nThat's an IS!
A blitz aimed at the moment our memories were scrambled.\nBut they're one step too late!
Intercept them!
Rika… this time I won't let you escape.\nThis time…!!
Alright, battle prep made it in time!
Black IS… I won't let you have your way!
This world… it's wrong…
Huh? What do you mean, 'wrong'!
A redo… is necessary…
A redo? Whatever do you mean?
I… wasn't supposed to be like this…
You're regretting something…?\nWhat on earth…
The right world… where is it?
The 'right' world?
Not enough… it's not enough…
Trying to confuse us? Useless!
Why don't you see it… why…?
I don't know what you're getting at, but\nwe have one goal!\nProtect Rika!
Houki's right!\nWe're protecting Rika-chan!\nDon't let the enemy near her!
Mii… stop this.
The world made the wrong choice…\nA choice that leads to ruin…
So… I'll go way, way back\nand redo it all…
I'm sorry, but that's impossible.
I've got nothing to lose… I have to try!
Oyashiro-sama no longer\nhas that much power left.\nYou must know that too.
There IS a way…!\nYou just can't see it…
Whether we need that or not\nis not for you to decide…!
…Why, why can't I win…?\nDamn it, not yet…!!
We're no longer just 'the two of us'.\nWe share our worries and our pain,\nand we support each other.
That's why we won't lose.
Problems you can't solve alone\ncan be solved together!
We won't lose!
You and us -\ndo you understand the difference?
That can't be… there's no reason\nfor me to lose…!!
She got away.
I propose we pursue!
Wait - we're fine, but\nthe ones on foot can't move that fast.
If we're slow to move out from here,\nwe'll be giving the enemy time.
What do we do, Mion?
True, charging ahead without thinking\nwould be dangerous.
But big sis, I don't think it's right\nto just wait here for the enemy to come again.
Isn't there some good move we could make, I wonder?
Charging straight into where the enemy\nis waiting would be bad.\nWe need some way to catch them off guard.
They've probably anticipated how slow we are,\nso they'll have a plan ready.\nTo turn the tables on that…?
You can count on me and Schwarzer Regen.\nDecoy duty or breaking through the center -\nI'll pull it off.
What're you showing off for?\nHibiki's not even here.\nOr are you cheating on her with Rika?
W-who's cheating on anyone!\nI'm used to operating solo, and\nI've had military training as a decoy!
Oh my, look who's blushing.
Hauuu.\nLaura-san's so cuuute.
H-hey! Stop clinging to me!
Ooh, a new romance discovered?\nI'll take a photo and show Hibiki!
Stop iiiit!
I'm taking you hooomee!!
Whaaat!?
Oh dear, she's done it now.
Don't just watch - somebody help me!
Nope.
Impossible.
No can doo.
At this rate,\nwhen the battle's over, all the IS pilots\nmight get taken home by Rena.
I… wasn't named, so I'm safe.
There was one attempt on me, though.
I'm not a take-home target either.
Saying that sounds dangerous to me…
Huh?
Hauuuu!\nI'm taking you ALL hooomee!!
Huh?
Called it.
…This total lack of tension -\nthe enemy would be shocked to see it.
True…
But this is normal for us.
This happiness, this warmth -\nI have to protect it.
We came to protect Rika-chan, but\nit feels backwards somehow, desuu.
For Rika-chan - the one who needs protecting most -\nto say that herself.\nNice! That's so cool!
I'm included in that too.\nThis time, I don't want to loop anymore.
All the more reason our next move matters.\nIt'd be nice if we could outsmart the enemy.
As for that, I've got a good idea.\nThanks to Rena.
Thanks to Rena?
The Flying Take-Home Operation…?
So we're using what we did to escape before\nas an attack this time.
So Houki carries me and [CLAUDE], Cecilia carries Shion,\nRin carries [MERU], Charlotte carries Rena,\nand Laura carries Rika-chan and Satoko.
So Houki carries me and [CLAUDE], Cecilia carries Shion,\nRin carries [NOEL], Charlotte carries Rena,\nand Laura carries Rika-chan and Satoko.
Akatsubaki has deployable armor, so\nit's just barely manageable.
Then what about Tsubasa?
No problem, go ahead.\nI'll catch up.
You're really gonna be okay…?
Uhyahhh! So high, so fast!
With this, it's one hop to the heart of Hinamizawa!
Not scared?
Miii, it's so high!
Higher, higher, take us higher, please!
Quite elegant, isn't it?
Yes!\nSo this is what flying feels like!
By the way, where's Tsubasa?\nCan she really catch up?
Sorry to keep you waiting!
Wh-what!? That's allowed!?
It has its uses!
I-I see, desuu!
What brute force!\nBut the enemy could never predict this!!
Don't forget to prepare for the next battle.\nThe enemy won't wait!
Tsubasa's right!\nThe moment we land, go into battle mode!
//END
